data.long_meaning: In Greek, Margarette is derived from Margharitē, meaning 'pearl,' or 'gem.' This name is likely inspired by St. Margaret, who was said to have been protected by a pearl in the sea. The name Margarette carries the meaning “Martha's pearl” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Margarette usually hope their child will grow to embody martha's pearl and live with faith, good character and purpose.
